# Paper v2 competitor baselines (bench/baselines/, bench/corrfunc/ of B2). OPTIONAL:
# each arm skips itself, with the reason in its JSON, when its package is missing.
# install_paper_v2_extras.sh installs every group on its own, so one that fails to
# build does not block the others. Same resolution as requirements-paper-v2-extras.
#
# kNN forward (bench/baselines/knn_forward.py)
jaxkd==0.1.2            # pure JAX k-d tree (github.com/dodgebc/jaxkd); runs on CPU too
jztree==1.1.0           # JZ-Tree, Stücker et al., arXiv:2604.05885
jztree-cu12==1.1.0      # its CUDA 12 FFI kernels (manylinux wheel, GPU only)
# kernel sums (bench/baselines/kernel_sums.py). sdists: keopscore JIT-compiles its
# kernels at first use, with nvrtc on GPU (needs the CUDA headers: CUDA_PATH or
# /usr/local/cuda) and g++ on CPU. Kernels are cached in $KEOPS_CACHE_FOLDER.
keopscore==2.3
pykeops==2.3
pybind11==3.1.0
# B2's xi_box.py (TreeCorr arm)
TreeCorr==5.1.4
LSSTDESC.Coord==1.3.1
future==1.0.0
PyYAML==6.0.3
setuptools==84.2.1
# Not pinned here, installed by hand if wanted (the arms skip without them):
#   Corrfunc==2.5.3  B2's Corrfunc arm; source build (gcc, GSL): pip install Corrfunc==2.5.3
#   jaxkd-cuda       jaxkd's CUDA extension (CMake + nvcc), see github.com/dodgebc/jaxkd-cuda
